description: Revert to the proven aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) configuration with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as the current best result (0.9800) was achieved with a conservative LR (0.08) that under-utilized the 5-minute budget, while historical data consistently shows the aggressive setup achieves better convergence (~0.983 bpb) within the time limit.
